# justingreenbaum.com

> Personal site of Justin R. Greenbaum — customer experience transformation executive, former Comcast Vice President, and founder of Greenbaum Labs. Twenty years leading national and global customer operations: digital and social CX, CX operating models, global service operations and high-trust functions, now extended through applied AI.

## About Justin
- Customer experience transformation executive; Comcast 2005–2025, frontline to Vice President
- Founder, Greenbaum Labs — independent applied-AI lab running on owned infrastructure
- MIT Sloan AI Executive Academy, NVIDIA infrastructure training, Prosci Certified Change Practitioner
- Creator of the Coherence diagnostic framework

- [Experience](https://justingreenbaum.com/about): Career arc, signature outcomes, education and credentials
- [Selected Work](https://justingreenbaum.com/selected-work): Five case studies with condition, role, action, and documented outcome
- [AI & Customer Experience](https://justingreenbaum.com/selected-work/ai-cx): Answer-engine measurement, AI system evaluation, global delivery, the portfolio operating model
- [Operating Method](https://justingreenbaum.com/operating-method): How he diagnoses operating failure — truth, authority, continuity

## Core Concepts
- **Truth:** Whether narrative aligns with evidence
- **Authority:** Whether decision rights match accountability
- **Continuity:** Whether decisions, rationale, and learning persist over time
- Technical and diagnostic work lives at greenbaumlabs.com
